ko.title: MS 리워드 자동화를 위한 Rewards Farmer

key_takeaways: Microsoft Rewards 포인트 적립 자동화 지원

en.title: Rewards Farmer: Automation Tool for Microsoft Rewards
en.hook: An open-source automation tool designed to automatically earn Microsoft Rewards points through scheduled tasks.
key_takeaways: Automates daily Microsoft Rewards searches and routine tasks
Includes simple setup flow backed by video guide
Saves user effort by streamlining repetitive actions

key_takeaways: 支持 Microsoft Rewards 每日搜索与任务的自动化
结合视频指南，配置与使用简单明了
批量处理重复性任务，有效节省时间
